list: Official 55-trophy list as published on PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18)
note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official text. Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each guide names where its facts come from. GTA VI had not released when this guide was written, so every method is built from the trophy's official description plus the community trophy listings — check the cited source for the latest community findings.

trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing to do for this one directly. Follow the roadmap in order (story first, side strands second, collectibles and grinds last) and it pops after the final trophy. Track your remaining trophies with the checklist filter 'not earned'.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission 'Gone Fishing' — Lucia's first outing after release — and finish it. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. No special requirement: just follow the on-screen objectives.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The chapter trophy pops when the final Chapter 1 mission ends and the next chapter begins. If you are rushing the story, keep playing the gold 'L' / mission markers in order.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 2. It pops at the chapter-complete screen. Note the name is censored with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. By this point the map opens up — use the downtime between missions to start collectibles (see 'The Goodtime State') rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale — after it, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, gold. Complete the final mission of the game. Before starting it, finish any missable trophies flagged in this guide — after the finale, some story moments cannot be replayed except through mission replay, and a replay may not re-trigger open-world conditions. Save before the finale just in case.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'Breakfast Run'. Follow the objectives; the trophy pops at mission completion. This is one of the named story missions with its own trophy, so do not skip it — mission trophies only pop on completion, not on replay of a failed attempt.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'The Cartel Heist'. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first — finish the setups, then the heist itself, and the trophy pops at the end of the heist mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'Child's Play'. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Named-mission trophies are straightforward: finish the mission once, any way you like.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'Headliners'. Finish it and the trophy pops at the end-of-mission screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'VCIA Takedown' at Vice City International Airport. The trophy pops when the mission ends. Do not confuse this with the open-world 'Catch Me If You Can' trophy — that one is a separate stunt at the same airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. The trophy pops at mission completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Gold. Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (pause menu stats). 100% in GTA games is a fixed checklist — story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and stunts — not 'do everything'. Work through this guide's roadmap and the checklist will fill itself; the last few percent are usually collectibles, so check the stats page to see which category is short. This is the second gold trophy and the real endgame goal before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Silver. Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and similar driving feats; the game counts each stunt as it happens and shows the running total in the stats. Best method: chain stunt jumps and near misses on the highways around Vice City in a fast car, and use stunt jump ramps whenever you see one. It builds passively across a full playthrough, so do not grind it early — check your count near the end and top it up then.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type at least once — fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, racing, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities. You do not need to win or finish them, just start and take part in one of each. The activity icons on the map mark the types; tick them off in the tracker as you try each one. Easiest done in one sweep after the story opens the full map.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each weapon class has its own challenge set at the range (Ammu-Nation). Gold means beating the score/time threshold for that challenge — use the weapon the challenge is built for, aim for headshots where scoring rewards them, and replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze. The range is repeatable with no cost per attempt, so grind the hardest ones last when your aim is warmed up.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are marked on the map once unlocked; each location has its own race. Winning needs a clean line through the checkpoints — cut corners where the course allows and avoid crashing, since a crash costs more time than a cautious line. Do one location at a time and tick it off; the tracker counts 14.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same one. Races are found at race markers around Leonida (street, off-road and water races). Pick a fast, grippy car for street races and the right vehicle class where the race demands it. Work through the map markers in order; 20 wins across the set is very doable once you have a tuned car.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests — the bigger the catch, the better the score. Use the best rod and bait you have, watch the tension meter so the line never snaps, and reel steadily during the fight. Cal is an early rival, so challenge him as soon as fishing challenges unlock; if you lose, you can retry the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game — play an arcade cabinet through to its end. Arcade machines are found in bars and arcades around Vice City. Pick the simplest game on the cabinet and play to completion; you do not need a high score, just a finished run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy. Finish Andy's mission strand — play every mission Andy gives you until his final one completes. Stranger and side-character missions appear as '?' / character markers on the map; work them between story missions so the strand is done before the finale.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy. Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Keep an eye on the map for Kenton's marker and do his missions as they appear — side strands can go quiet for a while, then reappear after story progress.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy. Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Do Billy's missions when they appear on the map; the strand ends with a finale mission that pops this trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as '?' markers; each strand is a short chain of 1–3 missions. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so pick the ones nearest to you and finish them fully — a strand only counts when its final mission is done. This pairs naturally with the named side-character trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), which count toward the 8.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy. Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Randy's strand is one of the eight that counts toward 'Strangers & Freaks', so it does double duty.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy. Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Like the other named side strands, it counts toward the 8 strands of 'Strangers & Freaks'.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scenic viewpoints — beaches, hilltops and quiet corners — marked once discovered or listed in community collectible maps. Go to a spot, use the meditate prompt, and wait for the session to finish; the count ticks up per spot. A map sweep after the story is the cleanest way to clear all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting request points to one specific rare animal — follow his directions to its habitat (likely the Leonida wetlands or forests), track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly. Bring a scoped rifle and approach downwind; if the animal flees, leave the area and return rather than chasing it across the map.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, interiors, and hidden spots — and each set needs every card in it. Collect cards as you explore, trade or buy where the game allows, and use a community card map for the last stragglers. Three full sets is the target; you do not need every set in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Silver. Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo/share action — open it at landmarks, viewpoints and notable spots and post from there. The counter tracks distinct locations, so repeating the same spot does not help. Work through the map's points of interest; this pairs well with the exploration trophy 'The Goodtime State'.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's open-world objectives — stunt, combat, driving and exploration feats tracked in the challenges menu. They accumulate naturally during a full playthrough; open the challenges list, pick the nearly-done ones, and finish them deliberately. 50 is a fraction of the total, so focus on the easy ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it during the story while your partner is available. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner in the car (or on foot together), then lose the cops: break line of sight, hide in an alley or parking garage, and wait for the wanted level to drain. The trophy pops when the 4-star level clears while your partner is still with you. If your partner is not around, it will not count — do this before the finale.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it while your partner is available in free roam. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row: aim at the clerk, take the cash, leave, and immediately hit the next shop — without the wanted level ever dropping to zero between robberies. Keep the wanted level alive by staying in sight of the law just enough, but do not get caught. Plan a route of three close shops (convenience stores on the same strip work well) before you start.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every distinct vehicle you drive or enter counts toward the 100. Variety is the key: cars, bikes, boats, planes and helicopters all count, and rare spawns count the same as common ones. Drive everything you see — jack a new model whenever one appears — and the counter climbs. Check the stats page to see your count; a vehicle meet or showroom visit can add several at once.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus (slow-mo targeting) activation. Find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together — a gang hangout or a shootout — trigger Combat Focus and chain headshots quickly before the meter runs out. A high-capacity automatic weapon helps; if you run out of targets, let the focus end and try a busier location.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the sense that it needs a specific stunt: at Vice City International Airport, steal a plane (or otherwise take off) without a scheduled flight — an 'unscheduled departure'. Get airside, take a parked plane on the runway, and get airborne. Expect a wanted level; climb fast and leave the airport airspace for the trophy to pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the description is a joke about the military tank, and the trophy is earned in a tank-related encounter (steal or destroy Rhinos, or survive one). The practical route: find a Rhino at the military base or during a high-wanted-level rampage, take it or take it down, and the trophy pops when the tank objective resolves. Check the community trophy guides for the exact trigger once players map it — the official description deliberately hides the method.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE per attempt, retryable. Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected: go in masked, move quietly, smash the cases and get out before any alarm or witness triggers. A stealth approach at night with a fast getaway car parked outside works best. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, lose the cops, and try again; the trophy only counts a fully undetected robbery.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Silver. Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vault robberies are bigger planned jobs than shop robberies — crack the vault, grab the cash, and escape the police response. Each successful escape counts one; five total across the game. Bring a fast car, plan the exit route before you go in, and do not linger for extra loot once the vault is open.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one (ram it, block it, or blow the rear doors), grab the cash, and escape the wanted level. One successful escape is enough for the trophy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map is divided into named areas; visiting each one counts it. Drive, fly or sail through every region — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, the beaches and the inland towns. The map fills in as you go, and the stats page shows how many areas remain; finish the stragglers with a helicopter sweep after the story.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run stash houses, drug labs and other illegal operations around Leonida — find one per gang, rob it, and escape. Gang territories are marked by their presence on the street; the operations appear as targets once discovered. One per gang, nine total.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE moment — a quiet one, easy to walk past. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view (sit or stand at the beachfront spot). The trophy pops when the drink-and-view moment completes. Do it the first time you are on Ocean Drive so it is not left to the endgame.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE per attempt, retryable. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front window and out the other side — the classic GTA showroom smash. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build speed on the road outside, and drive straight through. The trophy pops when you exit the showroom by smashing through it; expect a wanted level and a repair bill.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE moment at a specific place: go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, bowl a game, and complete the follow-through — the full bowling action the game prompts. Just play a full game of bowling at that alley; the trophy pops at the end of the game. Any alley will not do — it must be the Kolt & Associates location.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — a story partnership moment. The description is deliberately vague; it triggers on a specific partnership scene with mass appeal (a public moment with your partner). Play the story naturally and it should pop at the right mission; if you rush past story beats, you may miss the trigger. The community guides will pin the exact mission once the game is out — check the cited source if it has not popped by the finale.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the sense that it accumulates across the game: make choices — dialogue choices, approach choices, and moral choices in missions and free roam. The trophy tracks the choices you make; keep choosing (rather than skipping or auto-resolving) and it pops once enough choices are logged. Play through the story making active choices and this comes naturally.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something — a mission, a challenge, a stunt — then succeed on the immediate retry. The simplest route: deliberately fail a short mission or challenge once, then pass it on the second attempt, and the trophy pops. It is a joke trophy about retrying, so do not avoid failing — one honest failure followed by a pass is all it takes.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a random world event or easter egg. Leonida is full of odd encounters (UFO-style sightings, cryptids, strange NPCs); stumble into one and the trophy pops. It is luck-based, so explore odd places at odd hours and keep playing; the community will list confirmed trigger spots after launch — check the cited sources for the first confirmed locations.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE per attempt, retryable. Perform a melee drive-by: while driving, swing a melee weapon (bat or similar) at a pedestrian and knock them over. Slow down beside a pedestrian on foot, lean out, and hit them with the melee attack as you pass. One clean knock-down pops the trophy — the name is a bowling pun, but the act is a drive-by with a melee weapon.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep feeding bills to a contact until the laundered total hits $250,000. Robberies (shops, vaults, armored trucks) are the fastest source of Marked Bills, so this pairs with the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything bought in a shop counts. It is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds naturally as you gear up; if it is short near the end, buy ammo and car upgrades, which are the most efficient sinks. The stats page tracks total spent.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game. Garage properties are purchasable real estate that store your vehicles; they appear on the map / property site once unlocked. Save up — properties are expensive — and buy each one; the trophy pops when the last garage is yours. This pairs with the money trophies: laundered cash from 'Dime on the Dollar' can fund the purchases.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone, register a vehicle you own or have just acquired, and repeat for 10 different vehicles. Any vehicles count — the cheapest way is to register ten cars you already drive. The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase
